en: The national animal carabao lacks sweat glands, so it wallows in mud to lower its body temperature and survive extreme tropical heat.
Marcela Agoncillo and her daughters hand-sewed the first Philippine flag in Hong Kong while Emilio Aguinaldo was in exile.
The Philippine President holds line-item veto power, allowing them to reject specific spending items in a bill without canceling the entire legislation.
The Ifugao people carved the Banaue Rice Terraces over two thousand years ago using only simple stone and wooden tools.
Dr. Fe del Mundo, the first Asian admitted to Harvard Medical School, later invented a makeshift bamboo incubator for rural babies.
Ancient Filipinos wrote on bamboo using Baybayin, an indigenous writing system consisting of exactly fourteen consonants and three vowels.
Bacolod created the MassKara Festival in 1980 to boost public morale during a devastating local economic and agricultural crisis.
National hero Jose Rizal was a polyglot who could speak twenty-two different languages, including Latin, Greek, and ancient Sanskrit.
Despite being our national flower, the sampaguita is not native to the Philippines and was introduced by Spanish colonizers centuries ago.
A 1973 constitutional change lowered the Philippine legal voting age from twenty-one to eighteen, instantly granting millions of youth electoral rights.
Lapulapu defeated Ferdinand Magellan in 1521 using native troops armed with bamboo spears and poisoned arrows, earning him recognition as the first Filipino hero.
The traditional bayanihan practice literally involved an entire community physically carrying a bamboo and nipa hut on wooden poles to a new location.
